prior_platform_description:
- **COM skills catalogue — configured Oct 6:** `9b8e682a9` on main/develop sets the verified Java catalogue in Server Helm env: FD ranks map to IDs 1, 2, 3, 7, 8; seven professional skills map to IDs 13–19. Source: live `/user/levels/options` (HTTP/envelope 200). Server parser and COM/CN Helm rendering passed; CN explicitly does not inherit COM IDs. First authenticated post-push check still returns 503: verify Argo/serving rollout before acceptance. COM mappings no longer require inventing or obtaining IDs; CN verification remains separate. Evidence: `docs/com-qualification-catalog-2026-10-06.json`.
- **Spreadsheet recheck — `b3b673b7d`:** Withdrawals/contracts/reviews/purchase selection still return 404, disputes reject `lifecycle`, and skill catalogue returns 503. Available Crew denies task creation; Studio has no existing canvas and Admin redirects to login. Rows B3:B26 and exact limits: `docs/pax-checklist-recheck-2026-10-06.json`. Daily Web/Mobile discovery foundations are implemented but inactive pending Pax’s design: #624.
- **Pax UI follow-up — 0be5f8d36:** Clarified canvas status-read failure with a distinct icon and copyable job ID; differentiated Position/Task/Crew actions, capitalization and narrow-screen wrapping. Fixed literal validation placeholders across three locales. 78 Web + 22 canvas tests, both apps’ types/lint and 12 local browser fixture combinations passed; `docs/pax-ui-follow-up-2026-10-06.json`. Web Production labels/help now verified live; full status/validation journey acceptance remains pending.
- **Creator-skill catalogue — Isaac/Yuanzheng:** Pax’s exact error comes from missing or invalid `CREW_QUALIFICATION_CATALOG_JSON`. Provision authoritative regional Java FD/skill certificate IDs in the serving Server environment, roll out, then verify `/aurora/crew-qualification-catalog` and real eligibility. Retry alone cannot repair configuration; do not substitute fixture IDs or bypass requirements.
- **Canvas status lookup — remaining:** MiniMax/Wan cards show unavailable when `/aurora/ai/jobs` fails or omits a requested job. Obtain an affected job ID and lookup response/project scope to diagnose; this is separate from the Google provider investigation #623. Automatic checks and duplicate-submission protection remain enabled.
- **Release repair — Oct 6:** Replayed rejected local deploy commit `27d935a5a` on official `5828c2054` as `eeb8a0e18`, without force-push. Web/Studio target `0be5f8d36`; both ACR images verified and fresh Web navigation shows the corrected actions/help. Server/Admin UI still target `21f855b65`. Health/readiness are 200; AKS read remains denied, so pod versions, migrations and Argo sync remain unverified.
- **Live blockers — rechecked after deployment:** Withdrawals (`/me/withdrawals/balances`, `/me/withdrawals`), task contracts (`/me/task-contracts`), purchase-report selection (`/ip-commerce/me/report-purchases`) and public reviews return 404; disputes return 400, `Unrecognized key: "lifecycle"`. Studio reproduces the withdrawal-balance, task-contract, review and dispute failures too. Inspect ArgoCD sync, serving Server image IDs, migration/init and application startup logs, and ingress/service targets; the specific rollout/routing cause is not confirmed. Finance: #621.
- **Urgent rollout diagnosis — `2672b51ff`:** Read-only helper: `node deploy/diagnose-com-server.mjs 21f855b65fc59e347027308b71ad8225156ddeb6` (optional second argument: kubectl context). Isaac/release owner should share its JSON: ArgoCD revision/state, desired versus ready-pod images, init/container failures and service/ingress targets. Six fixture tests passed; deploy output now distinguishes publication from verified rollout. Current account cannot read AKS or Key Vault secret metadata and has no kube context. Payout-key mapping exists in the chart; missing/invalid key, failed migration and routing remain hypotheses until runtime evidence is available. Do not remove boot checks or rotate encryption keys as a workaround.
- **Follow-up audit — `28071575d`:** Fixed terminal Gemini quota/account/service failures being mislabeled as content moderation, and explicit HTTP 400 rejection becoming retryable when its message mentions a deadline. 64 provider/policy tests, 14 Studio error tests, all Server types/build and changed-file lint passed. Bounded source/issue re-review found no further confirmed independent local fix; details: `docs/repository-follow-up-audit-2026-10-06.json`. This Server change needs rollout after the existing runtime blocker is diagnosed; #623 retains the affected-job investigation.
- **Task-first acceptance:** Existing/new Crew entry, task-linked positions/invitations, atomic member/task acceptance, delivery folders/templates, reciprocal reviews and future-public/historical-private review rules are implemented. Live QA was rechecked and remains blocked because the available Crew denies task creation and the approved new private QA Crew requires AI Producer certification. Provide a suitable test Crew/accounts, then exercise create → invite/recruit → accept → submit → approve/review → profile; confirm regional skill catalogs and production privacy.
- **Contracts/resolution acceptance:** Multiple immutable originals/addenda, archived discovery, authorized downloads, classified disputes/private initial evidence and IP/purchase reports are implemented. After API repair, verify authenticated files/downloads and creator → admin → creator case outcomes. Confirm signature associations, policy URL/response commitment, evidence-retention duration and external general cash-complaint contracts; do not invent deadlines, refunds or deletion rules.
- **Creator/Studio acceptance:** Live creator discovery now lists uncertified creators; Service & Comment is restored. Pax’s OPC identity, real generation countdown and native hover preview still need verification. Committed Studio fixes (`30c67a7a8`) connect Help to localized FAQ and Discord to its QR popover, and remove the unsupported desktop placeholder; Chrome/types/lint passed. No whole-product visual acceptance is claimed.
- **Pax’s video/API failure — #623:** Provider-error mapping and copyable Studio failure details are committed in `21f855b65`; SDK and browser checks passed. Pax suspects the API; identify the affected job/provider response and verify the deployed generation and charging outcome before closure.
- **Storyboard:** Canvas timeline, drag/drop, ordered playback/reorder and shared-document persistence are implemented, including durable saved-storyboard FFmpeg export with private output/recovery. Interactive Story merging/export stays excluded per Isaac. Verify an authorized populated canvas, reconnect/persistence, regional storage, worker capacity and end-to-end export; local PostgreSQL/FFmpeg and fixture browser checks are not production acceptance.
- **Payments/reviews — decisions:** Versioned monthly/upfront/completion terms are implemented; confirm signed task-template mapping. Producer response-time scoring still needs an authoritative SLA. Keep IP beneficiary/share rules and referral cash integration in #621, Academy/teacher contracts in #615, and future public reviews with notice separate from historical private reviews.
- **Dedicated open work:** Regional media-retention/storage acceptance #620; private archive inventory #622; affected invitation lookup #618; CN workflow/files #613; GPS activation #598; Mobile #582 remains a separate branch/scope; #34 is company policy. Resolved #597/#614/#616/#617 stay closed.
- **Regional acceptance — Isaac/Yuanzheng:** Verify COM/CN versions/migrations, private storage, R2/Ably, qualification catalogs and real role permissions. Complete publication → review → store → playback, uploads, recruitment filters, linked-project access, Admin uploads/reviews and News/Course HTML/sitemap. Validate payments/restore/refund exactly once, generation output/charge samples, finance authorization and source-to-film/rollback journeys; ownership is not finance authority and qualifications are not KYC.
- **Unresolved external/product scope:** Course progress/views/ratings, newsletter delivery, profile social links and service reviews/settlement; service-order delivery versions/revisions/Crew binding; ownership/backfill #565, cooperation proof/revocation/logo, template upgrades, handover/reminders #592, ratings/evidence/appeals #568, costs/shares/cycles/exits/refunds/delegation #590/#591. Backfills need samples, dry-run and rollback; no automatic transfers or points-to-cash conversion.
- **Proposals remain decisions:** Broader Map/news/confidence/3D, Studio search, merchandise, Text Adventure enhancements, World Model/provider spending, reviewed script-to-task budgets/handoffs, Agent billing/quota/long-film and advanced timeline features need agreed scope. Story owner transfer, legacy image editing and course categories/chapter groups remain outside this release; simulations are not production commerce.
- **Evidence / closure:** `docs/repository-audit-2026-10-06.json` adds 18 platform suites/121 checks, the remaining opt-in database suites, 1,000-beneficiary post/reversal query bounds and atomic outbox tests. Final types/build and changed-file lint passed; broader suite results and affected reruns are recorded without claiming one all-green full run. Earlier release/follow-up audits retain their evidence. Close after regional journeys pass and unresolved requirements are accepted, deferred or transferred. One description, zero comments.
